Effect reading: Mag×Var + Y-flip dominate the triage call — CF/BCF/boot agree whenever the oracle is clear; CF V_debiased often clips near 0 (honesty: leaf bias removed) while boot Var(u) is heavy-tailed.

talk.recommend: Ship CF leaf-debiased as LIVE default for scene triage (same calls as BCF/boot on existing boards; bias_ratio honesty). For CI coverage of mean-risk shift Δ: bootstrap is the conservative cover (wide); BCF is the audit posterior middle; CF tree-CIs are sharp but undercover quiet — do not use CF draws alone as a Δ confidence statement. Note: coverage uses raw (unmerged) CF draws; leaf-merge stays on for product Var(u) stability.
